author: user123456789
title: How to subtract a series from a dataframe with matching indexes
text:
up vote 0 down vote favorite
I have a DataFrame with a number of columns, and a Series . Both have the same DateTimeIndex .
I want to subtract each row's value in the Series from all the values in each row in the DataFrame
Here is my sample data: dates = pandas.date_range('20180101', periods=10) stocks = ['AAPL', 'GOOG', 'MSFT', 'AMZN', 'FB'] data = numpy.random.randn(10,5) prices = pandas.DataFrame(index=dates, columns=stocks, data=data) returns = prices.pct_change(1)
This gives me a DataFrame similar to the following
I then create my Series , which is the return of the basket of stocks basket = returns.mean(axis=1)
This gives me a Series similar to the following
Now I want to subtract the basket returns from each stock's returns: excess_ret = returns - basket
I am getting the following warning: RuntimeWarning: Cannot compare type 'Timestamp' with type 'str', sort order is undefined for incomparable objects return this.join(other, how=how, return_indexers=return_indexers)
This is the resulting DataFrame :
This used to work in pandas-0.16.2 , but I am now using pandas-0.22.0 , and it seems I am unable to subtract a Series from a DataFrame with matching Indexes now?
Questions: What is happening in this subtraction operation I am currently performing? How can I subtract each row's value in the Series from all the values in each row in the DataFrame ?
